legend: A subpleural cystic tumour is surrounded by a fibrous wall and contains abundant mucus.

legend: Columnar epithelial cells line the wall of the cyst. Most of the nuclei are basally oriented, but there is focal nuclear pseudostratification. The apical cytoplasm is filled with abundant mucin.
